tools.name: get_device_status
tools.description:
获取当前连接的 Android 设备状态：设备型号、Android/SDK 版本、实际 Root UID、
当前前台包名与 Activity、屏幕分辨率及 UIAutomator2 可提供的亮屏状态。

tools.name: get_ui_tree
tools.description:
【核心感知工具 - 替代慢速截图】通过高速 RPC 提取当前屏幕的语义化 UI 控件树。
返回每个元素的 `[#index]` 编号、类名、文本 (`text`)、描述 (`desc`)、`id`、中心坐标与可交互标志 (`flags`)。
后续可直接调用 `tap_element(index=N)` 或 `tap_element(text="...")` 精准操作！

only_interactive.description: 是否只返回有文本或可交互（可点击/可输入/可滚动）的控件。默认 True 过滤无意义布局容器
only_interactive.title: Only Interactive

keyword.description: 可选过滤关键词（匹配 text、desc、resource-id 或类名），留空返回全部
keyword.title: Keyword

max_elements.description: 最多返回的元素数量，默认 100
max_elements.title: Max Elements

tools.name: inspect_view_hierarchy
tools.description:
【Android 开发 & LSPosed 逆向专用】通过 `dumpsys activity top` 提取 ROM 暴露的原生 Android View 层级树。
具体耗时和可用信息取决于设备；相比 `get_ui_tree`，它可能额外提供：
1. 真实的混淆/自定义 View 类名（如 `com.baidu.BaiduMap...`）
2. 16 进制资源 ID 锚点（如 `hex=0x7f0a03fc id=app:id/search_box`）
3. 被隐藏的 `GONE [G]` / `INVISIBLE [I]` 视图节点！

keyword.description: 可选过滤关键词（如自定义 View 类名、0x7f 资源号、id 名称），留空返回顶层起全部视图
keyword.title: Keyword

visibility_filter.description: 可见性过滤：'ALL'（全部，含 GONE/INVISIBLE 隐藏广告锚点）、'VISIBLE'（仅可见）、'GONE'（仅隐藏）
visibility_filter.title: Visibility Filter

max_lines.description: 最大返回视图行数，默认 180
max_lines.title: Max Lines

tools.name: screenshot_annotated
tools.description:
【视觉兜底与界面审查工具】获取手机屏幕截图。安全图层/DRM 等限制仍可能导致空白或拒绝。
默认开启 Set-of-Mark (`annotate_elements=True`)，在图上直接标出 `[#0]`, `[#1]` 红框编号，
看图后无需猜像素坐标，直接调用 `tap_element(index=编号)` 即可！
注意：日常操作请优先使用 `get_ui_tree`，仅在 Canvas/地图渲染/游戏或视觉验证时调用本工具。

annotate_elements.description: 是否在截图上自动绘制可点击元素的红色边框与 [#index] 编号（Set-of-Mark）。默认 True
annotate_elements.title: Annotate Elements

max_width.description: 图片最大宽度（等比缩放以加速传输），默认 720
max_width.title: Max Width

save_path.description: 可选：将截图保存到本地磁盘的绝对路径
save_path.title: Save Path

tools.name: tap_element
tools.description:
智能语义点击工具。支持按 `#index`、`text`、`text_contains`、`resource_id`、`description` 或 `(x, y)` 点击。
默认在点击完成后自动返回新界面的 `post_ui` 控件树，实现单回合感知闭环！

index.description: 来自 get_ui_tree 或标注截图的元素编号（如 0, 1, 2）
index.title: Index

text.description: 精确匹配元素文本（如 '设置'、'确定'）
text.title: Text

text_contains.description: 模糊包含匹配元素文本
text_contains.title: Text Contains

resource_id.description: 匹配元素的 resource-id 或短 id（如 'search_box' 或 'com.xxx:id/btn'）
resource_id.title: Resource Id

description.description: 匹配元素的 content-desc 无障碍描述
description.title: Description

x.description: 兜底直接点击的横坐标 X
x.title: X

y.description: 兜底直接点击的纵坐标 Y
y.title: Y

wait_timeout.description: 若按文本/ID查找，最多等待元素出现的秒数，默认 3.0 秒
wait_timeout.title: Wait Timeout

wait_after_ms.description: 点击后等待界面响应的毫秒数，默认 0ms；需要等待请用条件
wait_after_ms.title: Wait After Ms

return_ui_after.description: 点击后是否自动抓取并返回新界面的 UI 控件树（省去下一步手动调用 get_ui_tree），默认 True
return_ui_after.title: Return Ui After

tools.name: input_text
tools.description:
极速中文/Unicode 文本输入工具。
可一步完成『聚焦输入框 -> 清空旧内容 -> 注入中文字符串 -> 按回车提交 -> 返回新界面 UI 树』，并自动保护系统原输入法不被篡改。

text.description: 要输入的文本；UIAutomator2 通道支持中文和 Emoji，不可用时明确返回失败
text.title: Text

index.description: 可选：输入前先点击聚焦的输入框元素编号 #index
index.title: Index

resource_id.description: 可选：输入前先点击聚焦的输入框 resource-id
resource_id.title: Resource Id

hint_or_text.description: 可选：输入前先点击聚焦的输入框提示词或文本
hint_or_text.title: Hint Or Text

clear_first.description: 输入前是否清空原有内容，默认 True
clear_first.title: Clear First

press_enter.description: 输入完成后是否自动按下回车/搜索键，默认 False
press_enter.title: Press Enter

return_ui_after.description: 输入后是否自动返回最新 UI 控件树，默认 True
return_ui_after.title: Return Ui After

tools.name: swipe_screen
tools.description:
智能滑动与滚动查找工具。
支持四向滑动、自定义坐标拖拽，或设置 `scroll_to_text="目标文字"` 让工具自动滚屏寻找目标！

direction.description: 滑动方向：'up'（手指上滑浏览下方内容）、'down'、'left'、'right'
direction.title: Direction

scroll_to_text.description: 可选：自动连续滚动屏幕直到出现包含该文本的元素为止！
scroll_to_text.title: Scroll To Text

return_ui_after.description: 滑动后是否自动返回最新 UI 控件树，默认 True
return_ui_after.title: Return Ui After

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: 发送系统物理/虚拟按键（返回、主页、多任务、回车、电源唤醒等），并自动返回最新界面结构。

wait_after_ms.description: 按键后等待毫秒数，默认 0
wait_after_ms.title: Wait After Ms

return_ui_after.description: 是否自动返回按键后的最新 UI 控件树，默认 True
return_ui_after.title: Return Ui After

tools.name: batch_ui_actions
tools.description:
【王牌去人机感工具】单次调用连续执行多步手机操作流水线！
当能够预判接下来的 2~6 步操作时（例如：启动应用 -> 等待首页 -> 点击搜索框 -> 输入关键词 -> 按回车），
必须使用本工具一次性下发，彻底告别『点一下停几秒等下一轮』的卡顿体验！
若中途某一步失败，会自动中断并返回当前停留页面的 UI 树供纠错。

steps.title: Steps

return_ui_after.description: 批量执行完毕后是否返回最终 UI 控件树，默认 True
return_ui_after.title: Return Ui After

tools.name: root_shell
tools.description:
【Root 上帝模式直通车】通过 `su -c` 在手机上执行任意 Root 特权 Shell 命令。
可执行诸如修改系统属性 (`resetprop`/`setprop`)、查看内核/挂载信息、操作 `/data/` 私有目录、管理防火墙等任意底层指令。

command.description: 要在手机上以 uid=0(root) 执行的 Linux / Android Shell 命令
command.title: Command

tools.name: start_activity_root
tools.description:
【Root 页面直达工具】利用 Root 权限强行穿透拉起任意内部私有 Activity (`exported=false`) 或 DeepLink Scheme，
直接一步跨越繁琐的开屏广告与多级菜单跳转！

activity.description: 目标 Activity 名称（支持未导出的私有 Activity，如 '.map.main.MainActivity'），留空则启动应用默认主页
activity.title: Activity

data_uri.description: 可选：DeepLink URI / Scheme（如 'baidumap://map/direction?...' 或 'https://...'）
data_uri.title: Data Uri

extras.description: 可选：Intent Extras 键值对（自动识别 str/int/bool 转换为 --es/--ei/--ez）
extras.title: Extras

force_stop_first.description: 启动前是否先强行停止该应用以确保冷启动，默认 False
force_stop_first.title: Force Stop First

return_ui_after.description: 启动后是否自动等待并返回界面 UI 树，默认 True
return_ui_after.title: Return Ui After

tools.name: manage_app
tools.description: 应用生命周期与权限管理工具（信息、停止、重启、清空数据、逐项尝试授予运行时权限）。

action.description:
操作类型：
- 'info': 查看版本名、versionCode、APK路径、UID、进程PID、签名与组件信息
- 'stop': 强行停止应用 (am force-stop)
- 'restart': 强杀并重新冷启动应用
- 'clear_data': 清空应用数据与缓存 (pm clear)
- 'grant_all_permissions': 尝试授予已声明的危险运行时权限，逐项返回结果；特殊权限需 app_permissions 明确设置
action.title: Action

tools.name: inspect_app_data
tools.description:
【零界面数据穿透工具】直接通过 Root 读取或查询 `/data/data/<package>/` 下的 SharedPreferences 配置与 SQLite 数据库！
无需打开应用界面，直接核查开关状态、缓存数据与内部表记录。

mode.description:
操作模式：
- 'list': 列出应用私有目录下的 shared_prefs、databases 和 files
- 'read_prefs': 读取 SharedPreferences XML 配置内容
- 'sql_query': 对应用私有 SQLite 数据库执行 SQL 查询
mode.title: Mode

target_file.description: 当 mode 为 'read_prefs' 时填 XML 文件名（留空读全部）；当 mode 为 'sql_query' 时填数据库文件名（如 'data.db'）
target_file.title: Target File

sql_query.description: 当 mode='sql_query' 时执行的 SQL 语句（留空默认查询所有表名与表结构）
sql_query.title: Sql Query

pref_key.description: 当 mode='read_prefs' 时可选过滤的配置键名关键词
pref_key.title: Pref Key

tools.name: query_system_provider
tools.description: 【后台零界面取证工具】无需下拉通知栏或打开短信 App，直接通过 Root 提取通知栏消息、短信验证码或读写系统剪贴板。

source.description:
数据源类型：
- 'notifications': 抓取当前系统通知栏所有未读通知详情（含验证码、推送标题与正文）
- 'sms': 直接读取短信收件箱最新消息
- 'clipboard_get': 读取当前手机剪贴板文本
- 'clipboard_set': 写入文本到手机剪贴板
- 'custom_uri': 查询自定义 ContentProvider URI
source.title: Source

value_or_uri.description: 当 source='clipboard_set' 时为要写入的文本；当 source='custom_uri' 时为 content://... 路径
value_or_uri.title: Value Or Uri

tools.name: read_logcat_smart
tools.description: 【智能 Logcat 诊断工具】支持按包名自动绑定进程 PID、一键提取闪退堆栈 (`crash_only=True`)、按 Tag 或关键词精准过滤日志。

package.description: 按应用包名自动解析 PID 过滤日志（如 'com.baidu.BaiduMap'）
package.title: Package

tag.description: 按 Log Tag 过滤（如 'MapAdKiller'、'AndroidRuntime'）
tag.title: Tag

grep_keyword.description: 按正文中包含的关键词过滤
grep_keyword.title: Grep Keyword

lines.description: 返回的最新日志行数，默认 100
lines.title: Lines

crash_only.description: 是否仅读取崩溃缓冲池 (logcat -b crash)，查闪退必开！默认 False
crash_only.title: Crash Only

clear_first.description: 是否清空旧日志缓冲池 (logcat -c)，默认 False
clear_first.title: Clear First

tools.name: inspect_lsposed
tools.description:
【LSPosed / Xposed / KernelSU 专属调试工具】
直接通过 Root 读取 `/data/adb/lspd/log/modules_*.log` 最新模块日志与已安装的 KernelSU/Zygisk 模块列表，
快速验证 Hook 是否生效、是否有 StackOverflowError / ClassNotFoundException 等异常！

keyword.description: 可选：过滤 LSPosed 日志中的关键词（如模块名、宿主包名、Hook 标记）
keyword.title: Keyword

lines.description: 返回最新日志行数，默认 100
lines.title: Lines

include_verbose.description: 是否读取 LSPosed 框架底层 verbose 日志，默认 False 读模块日志
include_verbose.title: Include Verbose

tools.name: deploy_and_verify_apk
tools.description:
【Android / LSPosed 开发一键联调闭环】
单次调用自动完成：
1. 安装本地 APK (`adb install -r -d`)
2. 记录日志起始时间，保留全局 Logcat 缓冲池
3. 强杀并冷启动目标宿主应用 (`am force-stop` + 启动)
4. 等待页面渲染与 Hook 注入
5. 自动汇总返回：是否有 Crash 堆栈 + 目标应用 Logcat + LSPosed 模块最新日志 + 当前屏幕 UI 控件树！

apk_path.description: 本地电脑上编译好的 APK 绝对路径
apk_path.title: Apk Path

target_package.description: 安装后需要强杀并冷启动验证的目标包名（如果是调试 LSPosed 模块，填宿主包名如 'com.baidu.BaiduMap'；如果是普通 App，填自身包名）
target_package.title: Target Package

launch_activity.description: 可选：指定启动的具体 Activity
launch_activity.title: Launch Activity

wait_seconds.description: 启动后等待钩子执行与页面加载的秒数，默认 3.5 秒
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds

log_keyword.description: 可选：过滤提取日志的关键词
log_keyword.title: Log Keyword

tools.name: file_transfer_root
tools.description: 【Root 级跨端文件推拉】利用 `/data/local/tmp` 中转与 Root 提权，支持直接拉取或替换 `/data/data/`、`/data/adb/` 等任意私有目录文件。

action.description: 'pull'（从手机任意 Root 路径拉取到电脑）或 'push'（从电脑推送到手机任意 Root 路径）
action.title: Action

device_path.description: 手机端路径（支持 /data/data/... 或 /data/adb/... 等受保护路径）
device_path.title: Device Path

file_mode.description: push 时赋予的目标文件权限，默认 '644'
file_mode.title: File Mode

tools.name: optimize_device_for_agent
tools.description:
【设备极速模式调优】一键将手机调校为最适合 AI Agent 高速操控与调试的状态：
1. 关闭系统窗口与过渡动画 (`animation_scale = 0`)，消除页面切换等待时间
2. 开启连接电源时屏幕常亮 (`stay_on_while_plugged_in`)
3. 自动唤醒屏幕并滑开锁屏层 (`wm dismiss-keyguard`)

zero_animation.description: 是否将系统过渡动画缩放设为 0.0；修改前保存原值，恢复用返回的 profile_id。默认 True
zero_animation.title: Zero Animation

stay_awake_while_plugged.description: 是否开启 USB 连接时保持屏幕常亮不息屏，默认 True
stay_awake_while_plugged.title: Stay Awake While Plugged

wake_and_unlock.description: 是否立即唤醒并解除锁屏遮挡，默认 True
wake_and_unlock.title: Wake And Unlock

tools.name: tool_catalog
tools.description: Discover v2 capabilities and the efficient Agent operating rules (no device connection needed).

tools.name: device_connection
tools.description: List/select ADB devices or connect/disconnect/pair host:port. Selection clears UI indices; no arbitrary default when multiple devices are attached.

tools.name: device_doctor
tools.description: Probe actual Root UID, ROM/SDK, installed command/dependency capabilities. initialize_u2 starts the UIAutomator2 helper and resets a failed connection.

tools.name: ui_snapshot
tools.description: Fresh semantic UI snapshot with stable document-order indices and snapshot_id. Supply since_snapshot_id for added/removed/changed nodes; compact omits the full element array.

tools.name: find_elements
tools.description: Query UI with AND-combined text/id/class/package/state/region predicates, regex and explicit nth. Does not click; returns all matches plus snapshot_id.

Selector.description: All supplied predicates are ANDed. Ambiguous actions need an explicit nth.
Selector.title: Selector

tools.name: element_action
tools.description: Act on exactly one matching element: tap/long_click/double_click/set_text/append_text/clear/check/uncheck/read. Ambiguous/stale/disabled targets fail explicitly.

Selector.description: All supplied predicates are ANDed. Ambiguous actions need an explicit nth.
Selector.title: Selector

tools.name: wait_for_condition
tools.description: Wait for exists/gone/foreground/shell-exit-and-output/stable UI. Missing UI transport never counts as 'gone'. Replaces blind sleep calls.

Selector.description: All supplied predicates are ANDed. Ambiguous actions need an explicit nth.
Selector.title: Selector

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Fill several fields (including Chinese/Emoji) and optionally submit in one tool call. Stops at the first failed field; returns final UI once.

Selector.description: All supplied predicates are ANDed. Ambiguous actions need an explicit nth.
Selector.title: Selector

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Execute a fully prevalidated UI/Root workflow in ONE call: launch/tap/input/key/swipe/wait/assert/shell/if/repeat/sleep/read_text. Supports per-step postconditions, on_error, bounded loops/deadline and trace. No blind retries of non-idempotent actions.

Selector.description: All supplied predicates are ANDed. Ambiguous actions need an explicit nth.
Selector.title: Selector

WorkflowStep.description: A bounded, prevalidated workflow. Unknown actions/parameters are errors.
WorkflowStep.title: WorkflowStep

tools.name: workflow_control
tools.description: Inspect or cooperatively cancel an active workflow from another request. Cancellation stops subsequent steps; in-flight device/RPC calls finish or time out first.

tools.name: saved_workflow
tools.description: Persist/reuse named workflows: list/save/load/run/delete. Save validates all steps before atomic storage; works across MCP restarts.

Selector.description: All supplied predicates are ANDed. Ambiguous actions need an explicit nth.
Selector.title: Selector

WorkflowStep.description: A bounded, prevalidated workflow. Unknown actions/parameters are errors.
WorkflowStep.title: WorkflowStep

tools.name: shell_execute
tools.description: Run an arbitrary Android shell command, optionally su uid=0. Returns real exit_code/stdout/stderr/timeout/truncation. Device-side timeout when supported; never invokes a host shell.

tools.name: shell_batch
tools.description: Run 1..200 CLI commands in ONE ADB process/Root session. Per-command exit codes and output, optional fail-fast; avoids one subprocess/tool call per command.

tools.name: adb_command
tools.description: Raw selected-device ADB command escape hatch (e.g. bugreport, jdwp, shell am instrument). Arguments passed directly to native adb, no host shell. Prefer typed tools for timeouts and validation.

tools.name: device_job
tools.description: Background device processes: list/start/status/output/cancel/cleanup. Use for logcat, instrumentation, perfetto, tcpdump if installed. Persistent handles, bounded stdout/stderr, incremental byte offsets and PID-reuse checks. timeout=0 explicitly allows indefinite work.

tools.name: device_files
tools.description: Root file manager: list/stat/read/write/append/hash/mkdir/chmod/copy/move/delete. Text or base64, atomic replacement, preserve existing ownership/mode, backup by default, optional compare-and-swap SHA256. Use transfer for large files/trees.

tools.name: app_action
tools.description: List/info/paths/launch/stop/restart/clear/enable/disable/uninstall apps; install/install_multiple local APKs (base+splits), explicit downgrade/test/permission switches. clear/uninstall remove user data.

tools.name: app_permissions
tools.description: Inspect/grant/revoke permissions or set a named appop. grant_runtime_all intersects declared permissions with device dangerous-runtime list and reports failures individually; does not silently enable all special privileges.

tools.name: export_apks
tools.description: Export an installed app's base APK and ALL split APKs to a host directory for development/testing.

tools.name: send_intent
tools.description: Root/nonroot typed Intent: activity/broadcast/service/foreground_service/stop_service, internal components, DeepLinks, MIME/categories/flags, bool/int/long/float/string/null extras. Reports am errors even if exit code is zero.

tools.name: system_settings
tools.description: Read/list/put/delete exact Android global/system/secure settings; returns command failure rather than claiming unsupported settings succeeded.

tools.name: agent_profile
tools.description: Apply/list/restore an Agent speed profile. Saves exact original animation/stay-awake values BEFORE changes and restores them (including absent keys) by profile_id on the same device.

tools.name: device_control
tools.description: Control wifi/bluetooth/mobile_data/airplane_mode, brightness, rotation, screen_size, density, volume, wake/sleep/dismiss_keyguard, notifications/quick_settings/collapse_panels, reboot/recovery/bootloader/shutdown. ROM support varies. Reboot/network changes may disconnect ADB.

tools.name: system_property
tools.description: Read Android properties or set them using setprop; resetprop=true explicitly requests the installed Root resetprop utility. Does not install/assume Magisk.

tools.name: content_provider
tools.description: Direct zero-UI ContentProvider query/insert/update/delete/call/gettype with typed bindings. update/delete require explicit where ('1' intentionally means all rows). ROM/provider authorization still applies.

tools.name: shared_preferences
tools.description: Read/set/delete typed private XML preferences (string/int/long/float/boolean/set). Writes stop the app, preserve ownership/mode, back up old XML and check its hash. values={key:{type:'boolean',value:true}}; leaves app stopped.

tools.name: sqlite_database
tools.description: Query a private SQLite DB without a phone sqlite3 binary; copies DB+WAL+SHM, parameterized SQL, BLOB base64 and bounded rows. write=true requires package+stop_app=true; backs up sidecars and installs an atomic checkpointed DB, leaving app stopped. Live reads are best effort. SQLCipher needs its own engine/key.

tools.name: app_data_archive
tools.description: Backup/restore one app's CE or DE private data as tar+SHA256 manifest. Stops app. Restore validates member paths/manifest, keeps pre-restore data backup, restores UID/SELinux; replaces data, leaves app stopped. Keystore/TEE/external storage excluded.

tools.name: port_forward
tools.description: ADB forward/reverse list/add/remove for tcp/localabstract/localfilesystem/jdwp endpoints. tcp:0 allocates a port. No host shell; no-rebind avoids replacing another debugger's mapping.

tools.name: device_diagnostics
tools.description: Collect summary/memory/cpu/graphics/network/crashes/activity/services/power or bundle. Executes probes in one ADB session; optional persistent host report directory for regression evidence.

tools.name: perform_gesture
tools.description: Perform a multi-point swipe path or pinch_in/pinch_out gesture through uiautomator2, avoiding repeated tap/swipe tool round trips.

Selector.description: All supplied predicates are ANDed. Ambiguous actions need an explicit nth.
Selector.title: Selector

tools.name: webview_control
tools.description: Fast WebView/Chrome control using exposed DevTools sockets: discover/pages/dom/click/fill/evaluate/navigate/close. Uses DOM/CSS instead of pixel clicks; only debuggable WebViews. evaluate/click/fill require optional websocket-client.

tools.name: record_screen
tools.description: Background MP4 recording: start/status/stop/pull. Start immediately returns job_id; stop sends SIGINT for MP4 finalization, pull after completion. ROM screenrecord limits apply.

tools.name: compare_screenshot
tools.description: Pixel regression check against a local baseline PNG/JPEG. Captures one frame, compares dimensions/changed-pixel ratio/bounds, optionally saves current/diff; useful for Canvas UI verification.
